name: Akiyoshidai Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Japan's largest karst plateau, Akiyoshidai, with its limestone pavements and the Akiyoshido cave — the country's longest tourist cave.
notes: Managed by Yamaguchi. The Akiyoshido cave (¥1,300) and the plateau loop road are the core.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.notes: 山口県が管理。秋芳洞（1,300円）と台地の周回道路が核心エリアです。
